newsitem.title: USA: SEC declines comment on call for Calif. muni probe.
newsitem.headline: SEC declines comment on call for Calif. muni probe.

text.p: Securities and Exchange Commission said Thursday it could not confirm or deny that it was investigating or planning to investigate several California municipal bond deals following a call for a probe.
California Treasurer Matt Fong asked SEC to investigate nine bond deals, alleging they may have been "conducted in violation of state laws."

Paul Maco, director of the office of municipal securities at the SEC, declined to confirm or deny any probes of the deals, adding: "We have many sources for our investigations, including complaints from the public and referrals."
The nine bond issues were underwritten by Pacific Genesis Group Inc. An official with Pacific Genesis declined to comment early Thursday, saying he had yet to see Fong's letters.
